# Security Policy

Security is our #1 priority.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: open the affected repository's **Security** tab and select **Report a vulnerability**. Never report a vulnerability in a public issue. Include the affected version, impact and steps to reproduce; do not include real credentials.

## What happens next

Maintainers will investigate, keep you informed and coordinate disclosure. Security fixes are released as soon as they are ready.

## Supported versions

The latest release receives security fixes.
